fr_html: Le PRESIDENT répond que les idées contenues dans son avant-projet peuvent se rapprocher d'autres idées suivant le cours de la discussion.
en_html: The PRESIDENT answered that the ideas contained in his draft-plan and the other ideas put forward might become reconciled in the course of the discussion.
